No map. No waiting.
Breath cuts in. Air sharp.
Boots find ground. Boots find ground.

[Verse 1]
Sidewalk cracks and lifts,
Street hum breaks apart,
Trash curls in the gutter,
Every step folds the world backward.

[Pre-Chorus]
No slow. No thought.
Just moving through the cold.

[Chorus]
Still moving.
Still cutting false streets from my spine.
Still faster.
Still louder than the breath in the cold.

[Verse 2]
Left shoulder heavy with stitched skin.
Shadows don’t matter.
People don’t matter.
Only the next broken street matters.

[Bridge]
